integrity.statement: An analytic proof and reproducible rational checks are supplied. Historical priority remains qualified; independent review has not occurred.

scientific_limitations: The result applies to independent equal-width single-probe strata on the unit interval and nondecreasing [0,1]-valued Lipschitz integrands.
No other sampler, optimized partition, multivariate integration, or higher-moment claim is made.
The verifier is finite and diagnostic; the analytic proof supplies infinite-dimensional validity.
title: Sharp finite-sample variance of independent stratified integration for bounded monotone Lipschitz functions
